title: n!·β(u) as the sum of β(e_I)·det(⟨e_{I(b)}, u_a⟩) over all index maps I
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let e_0, …, e_{P−1} be an orthonormal basis of ℝ^P (indexed by Fin P), let β be an n-covector on ℝ^P and let u = (u_0, …, u_{n−1}) ∈ (ℝ^P)^n. Then n!·β(u) = Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P} β(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) · det(⟨e_{I(b)}, u_a⟩)_{a,b ∈ Fin n}. The sum runs over all maps I : Fin n → Fin P, and the matrix has entry ⟨e_{I(b)}, u_a⟩ in row a and column b.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)) (β : Covector (Euclid P) n) (u : Fin n → Euclid P), (n.factorial : ℝ) * β u = ∑ I : Fin n → Fin P, β (fun a => e (I a)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (e (I b)) (u a))
